title: Retain the confirmed translation language
steps: Inspect the loaded Contributor Dashboard Admin page and the Language dropdown under Manage supported languages for auto-translation.
Open the Language dropdown and use keyboard type-ahead and Arrow Down to highlight English.
Press Enter to confirm English and inspect the closed Language field.

video_guide.summary: English is highlighted in the open language chooser and displayed in the closed field after confirmation.

chapters.note: The Language and Provider fields show placeholders, Add is disabled, and the automatic-suggestions switch is off.

chapters.label: Open the Language chooser and use the keyboard to highlight English.

chapters.note: English is highlighted in the open language list.
The closed Language field displays English.
The Language field displays English, Provider shows its placeholder, Add is disabled, and the automatic-suggestions switch is off.
